mode: Window-free egui and lint checks only; no native-window, desktop, file-dialog or rendered-preview launches.

focused_gui.scope: Seven aligned 40-point rows, selected rectangular-mode marker, disabled availability tooltips, safe preview clicks, real Select all and Deselect publications exactly once, and unchanged document pixels. Tests use configured v11 at 1360x900 scales 1 and 2, 360x360 scale 1 and 480x360 scale 2, light/dark and forced repeated layout.

scope: Selection presentation lives in its own module, with 22-point icons, a shared label column, right-aligned shortcut hints and a selected-mode accent marker. Reference choice ordering is retained; Deselect is a separate working PaintCraft extension below the reference choices. The menu scrolls to keep lower rows reachable on short windows.
limits: No new selection kernel is implemented. Free-form, invert, transparent-selection and selected-pixel deletion remain explicitly disabled with one explanatory tooltip each. Rectangular selection and shared Select all/Deselect retain existing host/engine behavior. Native/rendered reference parity remains unverified.
